notes.title: Eyes of War: Survive Update
notes.content:
The Survive Update brings thrilling new modes, strategic enhancements, powerful new characters, and countless improvements to Eyes of War. Whether you’re fighting to survive in the Survival Arena or mastering new technologies on the battlefield, your skills and your will to survive will be put to the test!

[previewyoutube=_oQ6eBfrGCA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]NEW FEATURES & IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]

[h3]Survival Mode [/h3]
[list]
[*] Survival Arena mode offers a new combat experience where players select unique characters and fight to survive against endless enemy waves.
[*] Each wave becomes increasingly difficult, featuring different enemy types with unique strengths and weaknesses.
[*] Defeating enemies grants XP. Upon leveling up, players choose from a selection of randomly offered temporary Perks.
[*] Perks come in four rarity tiers: Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary.
[*] Enemies may drop loot containing health restoration, XP boosts, or temporary buffs.
[*] Loot is automatically collected when approached.
[*] Every 5 waves, a Market Screen appears where players can purchase temporary battle buffs (Battle Blessings) with gold or refresh choices using the "Dice Mechanic."
[*] At the end of the game, performance statistics (waves survived, kill count, damage dealt/taken, XP and gold collected) are summarized.
[*] Players can unlock permanent bonuses with earned resources, which apply to all future matches.
[/list]
[h2]Game Economy & Balancing Improvements[/h2]
[h3]🆕 Dedicated Workforce Technology[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Decoupled Worker Assignment[/b]
Adding workers to Lumber Camps and Mining Camps is no longer tied to Age advancements.
[*] [b]Improved Laborwork Tech[/b]
Research the Improved Laborwork technology directly at a Lumber Camp or Mining Camp to unlock +2 workers for each of those buildings.
[*] [b]Tech-Driven Strategy[/b]
This change lets you plan workforce growth via your tech path, adding more depth to building specialization.
[*] The durability of mine resources has been increased.
[*] The durability of tree resources has been decreased.
[*] Mining collection speeds have been rebalanced.
[*] Resource requirements for Age Advancement have been updated.
[/list]
[h2]🧙 New Characters & Integrations[/h2]
[list]
[*] Four new characters have been added, complete with all animations and system integrations:

 [b]Silveria:[/b] Maceman
 [b]Norvion:[/b] Huscarl
 [b]Solvong: [/b]Samurai
  [b]Veridia:[/b] Knight

[*] The Huscarl character no longer appears with a cape on their back.
[/list]
[h2]📘 Updated Tutorial[/h2]
[list]
[*] A brand-new tutorial has been prepared for first-time players.
[*] Compared to the previous version, it offers a shorter and more focused introduction.
[/list]
[h2]🗺️ Map Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Frozen Harbor and Serpent's Pass maps have been completely reworked.
[*] New Bandit Camps have been integrated.
[*] The "Suppuku" (self-sacrifice/harakiri) animation for the Samurai character has been disabled in Arena and Survival modes.
[/list]
[h2]🤸 Dodge System Update[/h2]
[list]
[*] Dodge animations have been revamped for smoother and more realistic movements.
[*] Previously, dodging was limited to forward, backward, left, and right. Now, dodging is possible in 8 directions:
[b]Front-Right / Front-Left
Back-Right / Back-Left[/b]
[/list]
[h2]⛏️ Resource Management Automation[/h2]
[list]
[*] Upon construction, mine buildings now default to focusing on Stone resources.
[*] Afterwards, each new mine building will automatically follow this resource cycle:
 [b]Gold → Iron → Stone → Gold → ...[/b]
Players can manually select resource types at any time.
[/list]
[h2]🎥 Camera Improvements[/h2]
[h3]🆕  New Dynamic Height Camera System[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Terrain-Aware Collision[/b]
The camera now dynamically adjusts its height to avoid clipping through elevated terrain (mountains, hills) in both Strategy and Battle modes.
[*] [b]Improved Target Focus[/b]
Fixed vertical alignment issues when locking onto characters—your view stays smooth and accurate.
[*] [b]Customizable Rotation Speed[/b]
Use the mouse scroll wheel to fine-tune camera rotation speed on-the-fly, fully respecting your global sensitivity setting.
[/list]
[h2]🏗️ New Structure Info Panel[/h2]
[h3]🆕 Enhanced Building UI On-Hover Info[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Detailed On-Hover Panels[/b]
Hovering over any structure in the Building UI now brings up a rich information panel with context-specific details.
[*] [b]Unit Production Preview[/b]
For unit-producing buildings (Barracks, Archery Range, Stable), the panel lists all trainable units and their key stats at a glance.
[/list]
[h3]🐞 BUG FIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where a single soldier would not move when issued a sprint command in strategy mode.
[*] Corrected localization errors in the Mine Camp technology.
[*] Fixed errors caused by repeatedly clicking the technology tab in resource camps.
[*] Fixed an issue where changing resources during the tutorial incorrectly increased the resource count.
[*] AI on Easy difficulty now properly produces soldiers.
[*] Fixed the issue where the "Under Attack" alert would persist after structures were destroyed.
[*] Corrected UI (user interface) errors on the main menu.
[*] Fixed sprite (visual) errors that occurred during group character selections.
[*] Fixed animation glitches for the Blade Master character during dodging.
[*] Resolved the issue where players would always take damage during a dodge action.
[/list]

notes.title: Eyes of War - Patch Notes
notes.content:
We’re excited to bring you a brand new update for Eyes of War one that sharpens the battlefield, refines your commands, and makes every siege more immersive than ever. Thanks to the incredible feedback from our players, we've introduced powerful new AI behaviors, improved troop controls, enhanced performance, and fixed a long list of bugs that stood in your way. Whether you're leading armies across towering walls or managing resources deep within your city, this update is built to make your experience smoother, smarter, and more strategic. 

Here’s everything we’ve improved and fixed in this major patch;

[h3]IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]

[b]Unit Control Hotkey Update[/b]
The unit control hotkey has been changed from [i]E[/i] to [i]F[/i] in RTS mode to prevent conflicts with camera rotation (which uses E/Q).
You can still use [i]E[/i] to switch between units in FPS mode, and the control can be customized via keybindings if preferred.

[b]New Combat Mode System[/b]
We’ve removed the old "[i]Aggressive[/i]", "[i]Defensive[/i]", and "[i]Direct Steps[/i]" modes. Replaced with two streamlined systems:
[b][i]Auto Mode: [/i][/b]Units make smart decisions based on surroundings.
[b][i]Manual Mode:[/i] [/b]Full control remains in your hands.

[b]TPS Movement Overhaul[/b]
Movement and turning in TPS mode are now more natural:
[list]
[*] Pressing S walks the character backward without rotating.
[*] Left/right turns now include realistic, step-based rotation no more instant spinning.
[/list]
[b]Sprinting Rework[/b]
Sprinting is no longer tied to “[i]Force Command.[/i]” Units will now automatically sprint (2x speed) when given an attack or movement command via double-click.

[b]Mining Camp Redesign[/b]
Mining Camps no longer split workers between resources using sliders.You now select one resource per camp (Gold, Stone, or Iron), creating clearer economic strategy.

[b]Dynamic Army Behavior[/b]
Army AI now responds intelligently to:
[list]
[*] Command type
[*] Duration of engagement
[*] Enemy unit size
[*] Risk level
[*] Building priority
[*] Target type (e.g., infantry, siege)
[/list]
[b]Tutorial Tweaks[/b]
Minor adjustments have been made to the tutorial flow and text to reflect recent gameplay and control updates.

[b]Siege Unit Speed Boost[/b]
Ballista and catapult units now move faster, allowing for quicker repositioning and less downtime during sieges.

[b]Battering Ram Targeting Mode[/b]
Rams now have a special attack mode where they target buildings exclusively, improving their strategic usage.

[b]Enhanced AI Combat Logic[/b]
A new AI combat mode has been added to improve how AI-controlled units detect, approach, and attack enemies.

[b]Keybinding Improvements[/b]
Assigning a new key now automatically clears conflicts, preventing overlapping controls.

[b]Save System Optimization[/b]
The save/load system has been optimized to significantly reduce lag spikes during saves.

[b]AI Resource Management Polish[/b]
AI players now gather and manage resources more efficiently, improving both ally and enemy economy behavior.

[b]Music Transitions Improved[/b]
Strategy mode background music now features smoother transitions and reduced repetition.

[b]Wall Climbing Restrictions[/b]
Large units such as elephants and camels can no longer climb onto walls, fixing immersion-breaking scenarios.

[b]Wall Command Fixes[/b]
Players can now issue proper commands to units stationed on castle walls, ensuring smooth control and defense setups.

[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed movement issues with battering rams.
[*] Fixed damage output issues for battering rams in multiplayer mode.
[*] Fixed UI issues where the TAB command didn’t close gate UI in multiplayer.
[*] Fixed crashes during siege battles involving siege units in multiplayer mode.
[*] Fixed issue where old saves were deleted after saving and exiting in singleplayer strategy mode.
[*] Fixed pathfinding errors causing units to move in different directions when ordered onto walls.
[*] Fixed incorrect horse spawn positions after loading a saved game.
[*] Fixed incorrect unit formations after loading a save.
[*] Fixed material issues with catapult crew units.
[*] Fixed missing "Win - Lose" panel after battle mode ends.
[*] Fixed incorrect spawn positions for siege units.
[*] Fixed an issue where bandits attacked from inside the battering ram.
[*] Fixed tutorial task bug preventing resource gathering task completion.
[*] Fixed an issue in singleplayer strategy mode where AI could not produce units.
[*] Fixed gate UI issues in strategy mode.
[*] Fixed material issues in Solvong faction buildings.
[*] Fixed various catapult-related bugs.
[*] Fixed notification bugs in strategy mode.
[*] Fixed issues related to the battering ram.
[*] Fixed language-related issues.
[*] Fixed unit formation problems.
[/list]

notes.title: Echoes of War
notes.content:
[b]Commanders, the battlefield echoes with sound! ⚔️[/b]
The latest update for Eyes of War makes the battlefield more immersive than ever! Your soldiers no longer just fight they now respond to your commands with voice cues, moving like a real army. Each kingdom has its own unique war cries, formation commands, and leader voiceovers, bringing the battlefield to life like never before!

But this update isn’t just about voiceovers! Performance improvements, graphic optimizations, and bug fixes have made the game experience smoother than ever. Your armies now move more fluidly, and the visual and mechanical details on the battlefield have been enhanced. Here are the details:

[h3]NEW FEATURES[/h3]
[b]240 Unique Unit Voice Lines[/b] 
Infantry, Archers, Cavalry, and Siege Units now have their own battle lines, making each unit feel more distinct!

[b]Kingdom-Specific Voice Styles [/b]
Veridia, Silveria, Norvion, and Solvong each have a unique voice style, making their presence on the battlefield more powerful.

[b]Command Voice Responses in TPS Mode[/b]
When you issue commands using the TAB key, your leader will respond with a voice confirmation, making tactical commands even more immersive.

[b]Formation Orders with Voice Feedback[/b] 
Switching between formations like Wide, Wedge, Loose, and Circular now includes voice confirmations.

[b]A More Realistic Battle Atmosphere[/b]
Your soldiers instantly follow your orders, making the battlefield feel more alive!

[h3]A COMMAND EXPERIENCE LIKE NEVER BEFORE![/h3]
[b]Issue Tactical Unit Commands[/b] 
Give orders like [i]"Attack!"[/i], [i]"Charge!"[/i], [i]"Hold!"[/i], or [i]"Defend!"[/i], and your army will immediately respond, ensuring full control over the battlefield.

[b]Rally Your Troops[/b]
Call out [i]"Everyone!"[/i], [i]"Archers!"[/i], or [i]"Cavalry!"[/i], and watch your units instantly react.

[b]Formation Control in TPS Mode[/b]
Experience a more immersive battle as your leader audibly announces formation changes.

[b]Seamless Integration[/b]
Every voiceover is carefully designed to enhance player feedback, making battles feel more dynamic and fluid.

With this update, commanding your army is more powerful and intuitive. Whether leading from the RTS view or fighting directly in TPS mode, your presence as a commander has never felt this impactful!

notes.title: Age Advancement Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We are beyond excited to announce the delivery of "[b]The Age Advancement Update[/b]," the first part of our roadmap! 🎉 But that's not all this update is packed with tons of new features and countless bug fixes to enhance your overall game experience! 😉

[b]🔥 Age I: [/b]Focuses on building a strong foundation with basic economy and resource gathering.

notes.title: Path To Victory Update Is Now Available
notes.content:
With the [b]Path to Victory Update[/b], the Eyes of War experience becomes even more strategic, fluid, and epic. This update introduces a range of new mechanics that allow your soldiers on the battlefield to move more effectively as a group, while also bringing optimizations that make it easier to defeat your enemies. These improvements not only give you greater control in large battles but also add strategic depth, enhancing the overall flow and pace of the game. Additionally, numerous bug fixes have been implemented to resolve issues players have encountered. All the details await you below!

[h3]NEW FEATURES AND IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
[list]
[*] A group system has been implemented for soldiers when selected together and given orders, optimized for the pooling system.
[*] When a soldier dies in a group, a soldier from the rear rows will move forward to fill the gap.
[*] The formation system has been enhanced by increasing the number of soldiers in the front line, widening the formation, and strengthening the feeling of an army.
[*] A system has been added to allow characters to push each other; stronger characters can push weaker or equal characters.
[*] When soldiers are selected as a group, they no longer act individually but move and attack as a group. 
[*] When attacking, all group members attack simultaneously; when moving, they move as one, without making individual decisions.
[*] The enemy detection system has been updated, delegating enemy detection tasks to the group leader. The detection range has been increased, and the range for some ranged units has been expanded.
[*] The system now checks whether the enemy is in the fog of war and whether the unit can attack that type of enemy before engaging.
[*] Non-mechanical units will no longer automatically attack walls.
[*] Soldiers are now programmed to prioritize attacking nearby enemy units over buildings.
[*] AI units have been adjusted to deal damage to only one enemy at a time during an attack, preventing multiple deaths from a single sweeping attack.
[*] When a command is given to a group, soldiers are now prevented from breaking the command for three seconds.
[*] The distance soldiers can approach one another has been noticeably increased.
[*] A new mechanic has been added where, when given a walking command, soldiers will pivot to face their destination before moving.
[*] In aggressive mode, groups will begin chasing enemies within their detection  range and attack once in range. 
[*] In defensive mode, they will wait until the enemy enters their attack range before engaging.
[*] Melee groups now maintain their formation during attacks, and once close to the enemy, they will start running to enhance the collision impact.
[*] For cavalry groups, a charge mechanic has been developed where, if not in defensive mode, they will perform a collective charge to break enemy lines.
[*] Enemies hit by this charge will be staggered and take damage.
[*] For archers and machines, mechanics have been developed to target and eliminate enemies collectively.
[*] Necessary systems have been implemented for group mechanics to function naturally in multiplayer mode.
[*] The issue causing abrupt camera transitions has been fixed; when transitioning from RTS to character mode, the camera will first zoom into the character’s upper body before entering their view.
[*] Camera view codes have been optimized for performance.
[/list]
[h3]Unit Damage Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*] The damage values for all unit types have been reviewed. Attack power has been optimized to better balance the units.
[/list]
[h3]Defense System Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*] The durability of buildings has been increased. This allows defense-focused players to have their castles and structures withstand sieges for longer.
[/list]
[h3]Structure Damage Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*] The damage output of siege units on buildings and structures has been adjusted. More strategic attacks on structures are now encouraged. 
[*] Additionally, the damage balance of siege units against infantry and cavalry units has been refined.
[/list]
[h3]Structure and Unit Resource Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*] The resources required for building construction and unit production have been rebalanced. Fairer resource requirements have been established to suit the playstyle of each civilization. 
[*] Special unit costs have been adjusted, allowing players to optimize their strategies while maintaining balance between civilizations.
[/list]
[h3]Technology Resource Balancing [/h3]
[list]
[*] The wood, stone, iron, and gold requirements for technologies have been reorganized based on their importance and impact in the game. 
[*] Resource requirements for early-game technologies have been reduced, enabling players to advance technologically at earlier stages. 
[*] For late-game technologies, the requirements for gold and iron have been increased, emphasizing the importance of resource management in the later stages of the game.
[/list]
[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed allocation errors in villager, soldier, and group codes that were causing FPS drops and stutters.
[*] Fixed the catapult aiming issue in the siege workshop in strategy mode.
[*] Fixed the issue where the "Mace Warrior" from Silveria did not have a shield properly equipped.
[*] Fixed the issue preventing new buildings from being constructed on demolished plots for an extended period in strategy mode.

[*] Fixed the mispositioning of the main tower in the "Barren Dunes" background of the main menu.

notes.title: The Civilization Ascension Update Is Now Available
notes.content:
Greetings Warriors! 

The Civilization Ascension Update is Now Available!

We are introducing special bonuses for the four civilizations in the game. These Civilization Bonuses will be applied to the player's civilization from the start of each game. The bonuses are fixed, meaning they cannot be lost or changed, and they will provide unique traits that affect gameplay from beginning to end. Additionally, we are introducing new unique technologies exclusive to each civilization, offering strategic advantages that are unavailable to others.
Below are examples of Civilization Bonuses and unique technologies. Please note that these examples are subject to change and are not final.
In this update, we are also addressing changes to horse armor and dodge mechanics.

[h1]Statues and Technological Advancements[/h1]
Accelerate the progress of your civilization! Statues become more functional in the next level of technologies, able to unlock technological advancements, making these magnificent structures much more useful for your faction.
[h1]1. Silveria[/h1]
Focus 1: Cavalry (mounted units)
Focus 2: Archers
[h3]Civilization Bonuses[/h3]
[list]
[*] Start with more wood and stone.
[*] All technologies are free but take much longer to complete.
[*] Stable buildings are cheaper compared to other civilizations.
[*] Archers fire faster than those of other civilizations.
[*] Mounted units have a wider line of sight.
[*] Archers are trained faster.
[*] Mounted units deal extra damage.
[*] Camel units are produced faster.
[*] Market commission is lower compared to other civilizations.
[/list]
[h3] Unique Technologies [/h3]

[*] Units gain damage or movement speed temporarily after killing an enemy.
[*] Towers have increased line of sight and attack range.
[*] Each mounted unit produced has a chance to grant 2 additional units.
[*] Main castle archers deal more damage.
[*] Archers on stone walls deal extra damage compared to other civilizations.
[/list]

Focus 1: Infantry
Focus 2: Attack Power
[h3]Civilization Bonuses[/h3]
[list]
[*] Start with more wood than other civilizations.

[*] Infantry units are cheaper.
[*] Infantries have a slight bonus against buildings.
[*] Barracks technologies are cheaper.
[*] Gain resources from destroying enemy structures.
[*] Axemen take less damage from enemy archers.
[/list]

[*] Increased attack power.
[*] Extra damage against enemy buildings.

[*] Towers have increased range.
[*] Siege units are cheaper.

The epic melodies of the battlefield shall now echo in your ears, for the sound of victory has

whisper's tone have been reborn to draw you deeper into the heart of the battle.

With the Music and SFX Update, you will feel the magic of sound like never before. The
triumphant shouts of victory on the battlefield, the ancient tunes carried by the wind—all will
now touch your soul, letting you witness the true voice of war.

In addition to the music and SFX update, weekly bug fixes have been made to the game. For
all the details;

[h1]Music[/h1]
Eyes of War is now brought to life with brand-new music, created under the leadership of
Güldiyar Tanrıdağlı and Doğan Saldanlı. The 12-piece Istanbul Strings orchestra combines
with the oud and lute performances of Caner Yılmaz and the percussion of Tarık Aslan.
Together, this talented team has crafted symphonic compositions that elevate the game's
atmosphere to new heights. These pieces offer a unique experience for each region and
faction.
In Norvion, the music pulses with energy, capturing the bold spirit of the North and its drive
for conquest. Meanwhile, in Solvong, the melodies are more subtle and mysterious, with
delicate notes that invite you to explore the deep cultural richness of the East. In Silveria, the
exotic sounds of the Middle East create a mystical atmosphere, while in Veridia, the
elegance of Europe and its classical music traditions bring the sophistication of these lands
to life through melodies.

The talented 14-member team behind these works is ready to take you on a journey through
the world of Eyes of War. Get ready to dive into new adventures in a mesmerizing medieval
world, all while being swept away by these captivating melodies!

Güldiyar Tanrıdağlı
Doğan Saldanlı

[b]Orchestra[/b]:
Strings: Istanbul Strings

[h2]Revamping of Building and Building Upgrade Sounds[/h2]

● New sound effects were added for various situations such as the construction,
upgrading, and destruction of all structures in the game.

notes.title: Eyes of War Major Update
notes.content:
[h3]Eyes of War introduces a completely new dimension to your in-game experience! Witness the captivating story of war as you encounter new maps and powerful characters. With these exciting changes, the fabric of the game is fundamentally transformed, inviting you to an unforgettable adventure. Are you ready to explore the might of war with this revolutionary update?[/h3]

[h2]Revamped UIs[/h2]

[h3]A comprehensive revision of User Interfaces (UI) provides players with more control options. Menus, resource management, unit upgrades, and more are designed in a user-friendly manner, enhancing the in-game experience.[/h3]

[h3]This breathtaking new map added to Eyes of War presents players with the mystical and colorful atmosphere of Asia. Serpent’s Pass stands out with its abundant flowers and natural beauty. Additionally, various environmental updates have been added to all existing maps within the update, allowing players to immerse themselves more deeply in the atmosphere of each map.[/h3]

[h2]Revamped Tutorial[/h2]

[h3]The redesigned tutorial helps players understand the game's basic mechanics and improve their overall approach. Narratives and a more explanatory approach make the learning process more enjoyable.[/h3]

[h2]New Characters[/h2]

[h3]The addition of new characters provides players with the opportunity to meet powerful warriors from different races. Each character's unique abilities diversify your options and personalize your gaming experience. Here are the newly added characters:[/h3]

[h2]Imperial Elephant - Solvong[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44061464/ea2782b0238fa8d5fc7ca92857334c6e4472643c.gif[/img]
[h3][list]
[*] A giant elephant archer equipped with high durability and toughness.
[*] Despite slow movement, instills fear in enemy lines with extensive range and impressive attack power.
[*] Can provide formidable defense against enemy armies.
[/list][/h3]


[h2]Dune Trooper - Silveria[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44061464/6689d142dd3a8e9e21f962ba3454bc3bb6428215.gif[/img]
[h3][list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44061464/2915e90fe5543453af5aa27f4999ee2741cd96ae.gif[/img]
[h3][list]
[*] A master of spear usage among mounted units.

[/list][/h3]

[h2]In-Game Notification System and Key Mapping[/h2]

[h3]The in-game notification system and key mapping options provide players with more control and information. In-game notifications offer guidance for beginners, while key mapping options stand out as perfect features for those who want to personalize their gaming experience.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44061464/2337002b2f58ddd6a3e90fe6f118f526f2118f2a.png[/img]

[h3]Balancing the damage-health ratio of all units and structures contributes to a fair and competitive in-game environment. This update allows players to strategize more balanced approaches.[/h3]

[h2]New Technologies[/h2]

[h3]Added new technologies enrich in-game strategies and character developments, offering players more options.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44061464/84f059c97f71e6f433ca8115bb175980a19e2f4a.gif[/img]

[h3]Changes to the combat mechanics of archer units make arrow shots more impressive. Archers can now target enemies more precisely and realistically, providing players with more tactical options.[/h3]

[h2]Changes in Control and Combat System for Mounted Units[/h2]

[h3]Updates to the control of mounted units allow players to use these powerful warriors more effectively. Simultaneously, improvements in combat mechanics make mounted units look more impressive on the battlefield.[/h3]

[h2]Catapult Ballista Control Update[/h2]

[h3]This update makes the use of catapults and ballistae more enjoyable. More precise control options, improved shooting mechanics, and camera angles transform using these massive war machines into a more user-friendly experience.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44061464/0b7942428315009eb774a11dbeb7de2c753597d8.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44061464/8f8dbbdfa6ae9ca330cbf1d348200db0c8e80fbc.gif[/img]

notes.title: Eyes of War: A Tale of Shining Kingdoms
notes.content:
[h3]Eyes of War brings together four unique civilizations, from the might of the desert to the brave people of the north, from the guardians of nature to the people who wield the power of the lion. Four different races await you with their own unique stories and characteristics. Here are the stories of these amazing races:[/h3]

[h2]Silveria: Rising Power in the Heart of the Desert[/h2]
[h3]Silveria is an empire that rises under the relentless heat of the sun. Ruling over the vast sands of the desert, the scorpion kingdom defines the identity of the Silverians. They are an intelligent and courageous people, woven together by patience and resistance, who have embraced the secret power of the scorpions as a cult. Inspired by the teachings of the scorpions, the Silverians are armed with the knowledge and skills necessary to survive in the desert. Silveria's goal is not only to rise in the desert, but also to use the power of the scorpions to solidify their dominance in the region.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44061464/c7a2f142eb735cd17a913ce8faa1e073a296419a.png[/img]

[h2]Norvion: The Resistance of the Valiant People of the North[/h2]
[h3]Norvion writes the saga of a brave, warlike and free-spirited people in the icy lands of the north, along the sea shores where darkness and storm reign. The Norvionese are a people who strike fear into their enemies with their brave armies. The raven symbol that flies proudly on their flag symbolizes invincibility and immortality in battle. The people of Norvion have defied the cold and harsh climate of the north to build a strong civilization. This is a reflection of their saga of courage and determination. Norvion is a symbol of a people who have maintained their freedom and independence against all odds.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44061464/ddac07354ae8d66020a95e3dce59d40cdf7d28ba.png[/img]

[h2]Solvong: Victory from the Essence of Nature[/h2]
[h3]Solvong represents a civilization dedicated to the mission of preserving the spirit of nature. The power of dragons runs through the veins of the Solvong. Brave and mighty warriors, the Solvong army is equipped with legendary weapons such as swords and bows. They offer ruthless resistance to their enemies and will accept nothing less than victory. Solvong culture is steeped in dragon legends, and their artists glorify their civilization by recreating the stories of dragons and keeping their epics alive in song.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44061464/94db049c6cd524d0726ebb242a202b8c66a56055.png[/img]

[h2]Veridia: Pride and Power of the Lion[/h2]
[h3]Veridia's ramparts, its mighty fortress and its towers reaching to the sky are a monument to victory itself, a monument so sublime that it terrifies its enemies. The heroes of Veridia are legendary for their bravery, fair fighting and devotion to each other. The lion symbolizes the power of Veridia and represents the courage of its people. This symbol beats in the heart of the king and the flag flying over the city walls strikes fear into the hearts of enemies. Veridia, like the lion's claws, is sharp, full of power and symbolizes freedom, representing an epic history written in triumph by its heroes.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44061464/cdf403d480c05514d15ae03ae23929a4a7e4e0c0.png[/img]

[h3]In the game world, these four unique races await you with their own unique strengths and strategies. Which race will you choose? What tactics will you use against your enemies? 

Eyes of War invites you to an epic medieval adventure. Explore the game now and build your own army to fight for victory![/h3]

notes.title: Eyes of War: The Fascinating Transformation of the Middle Ages
notes.content:
[h3]Eyes of War has been truly transformed with its latest updates. The evolution of the game is moving towards previously unimaginable details and visual richness. This visual journey, which we will share with our followers, reveals step by step how the game has evolved.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44061464/ccd30b9c6b19d72ac7b14b68e82e445a35f69acc.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44061464/99a73e3989909cf4138f5cee4bdda87e4c3360e0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44061464/c8fca612af5bc77b22b0eab51c399fc6dd788e13.png[/img]


[h2]1. More Detailed Realistic Trees[/h2]

[h3]Trees in the game are no longer just objects, but natural structures with realistic textures and details. Every leaf, every branch is similar to its real-world counterpart. Trees that used to just decorate the background now offer a visual feast that impresses players.[/h3]

[h2]2. More Detailed Sky System[/h2]

[h3]The sky is no longer just a static background, but a dynamic and immersive atmosphere. Cloud formations move in real time, giving the sky a natural vibrancy.[/h3]

[h2]3. More Detailed Ground Cover and Turf System[/h2]

[h3]Grass now vibrates in the wind, ground covers are naturally textured and detailed. The game world feels more realistic and tactile. Whether it's snow-capped mountain peaks or muddy plains, each area reflects its own unique structure.[/h3]

[h2]4. More Detailed Water System[/h2]

[h3]Water is no longer a still image, but is now enriched with realistic ripples and reflections. Streams flow, puddles form in realistic shapes and environmental details reflected by the water create a stunning atmosphere.[/h3]

[h2]5. More Detailed Fog System[/h2]

[h3]Fog now adds an air of mystery to the game world. The distance and atmosphere are rendered as impressively as the real world. The layers of fog on the horizon line increase the depth and realism of the game.[/h3]

[h2]6. New Terrain System and Environment Props[/h2]

[h3]With the revamped terrain system, the base of the game world is more detailed and richer. Also, thanks to the environment props, each area is richer and more varied with objects. Castles, stones, vegetation and many other details make the game world more realistic.[/h3]

[h3]With this visual evolution, Eyes of War continues to immerse players even deeper into the magical world of the Middle Ages. The updates add not only visual but also experiential depth to the game. New details and realism invite players into an even more enchanting experience.[/h3]
